messages:
Aisha: Dropping a short follow-up to today's all-hands re: strategy and competitors. Post tight questions and we'll answer.
Omar: For new prospects, lead with one primary differentiator — what should that be?
Aisha: Lead with reliability+economics: "Predictable inference at production scale." Then choose either latency proof or TCO example depending on the buyer.
Lina: Should marketing call out model coverage (open models) or stick to platform benefits?
Marco: Platform first. Mention open-model support as a secondary benefit: customers care more about performance and ops integration.
Eve: Any guidance for SRE when customers ask about failover across regions?
Aisha: Yes — for Dedicated we can promise regional routing and SLAs; for hosted explain fallback policies and cross-region options.
Omar: Competitors are aggressive on hosted pricing. Paper or messaging to help counter that?
Lina: We'll produce a short TCO playbook showing real-world examples with batching and caching.
ops-bot: docs.redwood.ai/sales/tco-playbook shared :link:
Aisha: Wrapping up  will close in 24h unless more Qs. Keep replies short.
Omar: Thanks, will loop Sales in.
